item.title: Sungrow Unveils PowerTitan 3.0 and DC-Coupled PV-ESS Platform in Europe

item.title: KPI Green Energy Lines up Sundrop Energia IPO, Sharpens Focus on Storage and EPC Pipeline
item.description: KPI Green Energy delivered its ‘seventh consecutive quarter of highest ever revenue’ in Q3 FY26, led by execution across its solar and hybrid portfolio. The company reported total revenue of INR 676 crore, up 45 percent year-on-year, EBITDA of INR 251 crore (up 73 percent), and profit after tax of INR 126 crore (up 48 percent). item.title: Websol Energy Q3 Profit Climbs To ₹65 Crore On Strong Cell Line Ramp-Up
item.description: Kolkata-based Websol Energy System Limited (Websol), a leading manufacturer of high-efficiency solar cells and modules in India, reported a 77.2% year-on-year rise in revenue from operations to ₹261 crore in the December quarter, compared with ₹147 crore in Q3 FY25. Websol Energy said its EBITDA rose to ₹106 crore, with a margin of 40.8%, from ₹68 crore a year earlier. item.title: BPCL Inaugurates 71 MWp Solar Power Plant in Prayagraj at IEW
item.description: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) has inaugurated a 71 MWp DC / 52 MW AC solar power plant in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The project was inaugurated by Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas Hardeep Singh Puri during India Energy Week (IEW). item.description: Luminous Power Technologies has inaugurated its first lithium-ion battery assembly line at Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, marking a key milestone in the company’s efforts to strengthen its advanced energy storage capabilities. The new facility aligns with Luminous’ long-term strategy to adopt next-generation energy solutions and enhance its manufacturing footprint in India, the company said. item.title: 2026–27: Kerala Allocates ₹1,309.84 Cr Budget to Power Sector, Adds BESS, Smart Meters, PSP
item.description: Kerala’s latest 2026–27 budget saw an upsurge in the state’s energy sector, with a strong emphasis on renewable energy systems, energy efficiency projects, electricity security programmes, and initiatives promoting green energy. In a budget speech, Kerala Finance Minister K N Balagopal spoke about increasing budget allocation for the power sector, which rose to ₹1,309.84 crore. Of this, ₹1,238.80 crore has been earmarked for the Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) for power sector development

item.title: Green Stocks on Jan 30: Pre-Budget Trade Sees Mixed Performance
item.description: As the stock market closed ahead of the Budget announcement, green stocks delivered a mixed performance. Shares of companies such as Acme Solar gained on the back of positive financial results, while NTPC Green fell more than 6% following reporting a loss in profit within its Q3 results. Vikram Solar and Sterling and Wilson also recorded gains of over 2%, along with Oswal Pumps, which rose more than 4% during the trading session.
